svg.title: The demo
svg.desc: The demo's frame: a fountain of warm sparks rising from the floor, brightest at the core, spraying outward and falling onto a dark floor, with a metal torus standing on edge to the right that hides the sparks falling behind it.
svg.text: particles --shot: 65,536 slots, 2.5 s in, simulated on the GPU (the region around the fountain).
Palette-snapped for the page: five tints, eight levels.
